subject: science
passage: For nearly three decades, the Pioneer 10 and 11 spacecraft, launched in the early 1970s, appeared to be slowing slightly more than known forces could explain. The discrepancy was minute, but because it seemed to resist every conventional account, some physicists entertained the possibility that it signaled a flaw in the theory of gravity itself. A painstaking reconstruction of how heat from the probes' power sources and electronics radiated unevenly from their surfaces ultimately rendered such speculation ______: the uneven thermal emission, once properly modeled, accounted for essentially all of the anomaly.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

explanation.why: The colon explains the result of the heat study: ordinary thermal emission "accounted for essentially all of the anomaly." If a known cause explains the slowing, there is no longer any need to suppose a flaw in gravity. The blank must mean "unnecessary."
explanation.A: Incorrect. Questioning established gravity theory was already controversial before the heat study; the study showed the idea was unnecessary, not that it was disputed.
explanation.B: Incorrect. A full ordinary explanation makes the gravity speculation less reasonable, not more, so "plausible" reverses the effect.
explanation.C: Incorrect. The heat study did not make the gravity idea impossible to test; it made the idea unnecessary by explaining the anomaly another way.
explanation.D: Correct. "Superfluous" means more than is needed. Once heat explained the slowing, the speculation about gravity was no longer needed.
